author: billy_sweeney
text:
Excited to launch @figma Motion! I joined this effort a few months ago, and one of the many things I’ve been able to design so far: Motion Styles! You’ll be able to save and distribute your own styles very soon. But to get you started, we have 36 premade styles ready for you to play with.

We have a ton of stuff in the pipeline, and are working hard to make this the best motion tool out there. Let us know what you need! We’re listening.

author: andrekaka1996
text:
Figma just made the design↔️code handoff obsolete.

Config 2026 ships Code Layers — any layer becomes a live code block, editable right next to the mockup. Changes flow both directions: tweak the design, the code updates; edit the code, the design updates.

They also added Figma Motion with a full timeline, keyframes, AI-generated animations, and direct export to CSS/JSON — animations become part of the design system, visible in Dev Mode.

One canvas. No more copy-paste between Figma and your editor.

For teams using AI coding tools alongside designers: does bidirectional sync actually reduce your back-and-forth, or does it just move the friction somewhere else?
